analysis: The build fails inside the Roslyn compiler process (csc) itself with a 'Method not found' reflection error on a .NET Cryptography API, indicating a corrupted or mismatched Roslyn/SDK toolset installation on the macOS runner rather than any issue with generated template code. This matches a previously seen pattern (templates-canewandbuild-roslyn-methodnotfound-macos) where a similar Method not found error occurred in the same CanNewAndBuild flow on macos-latest for a different template/SDK combination. The PR does not modify the Templates test infrastructure or template content that would cause this compiler-level failure.
